systemfields.description: This is the simplest example of APEX rig construction that also show how to pass custom inputs to the graph. This setup uses sceneinvoke SOP from Houdini 20.5 with extra animation parms input.

parms.python:
import apex.scene_2 as scenemod
node = hou.pwd()

if not 'sceneinvokesop' in locals():
    sceneinvokesop = scenemod.SceneInvokeSop()
sceneinvokesop.invoke0_(node)
